races.paceDynamic: Hurt You Never provides the sole confirmed pace angle and should get an uncontested lead with Keldeo, Blue Lakota and Harry Mole the only other forward runners unlikely to apply serious early pressure. This creates a moderate tempo that builds through the race as the large group of hold-up horses (Imperial Guard, Wen Moon, Harb, Fierce, Acrisius, Speeding Bullet, Dc Cogent) begin their challenges from the 2f pole. The lack of pace pressure early means the leaders can dictate fractions and have energy reserves for the finish. This race shape clearly favours prominent runners and those that can track the pace, as they avoid the traffic problems that will inevitably affect the crowded pack of hold-up horses in the sprint finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Hurt You Never gets first run and dictates moderate fractions without pressure
scenarios.body: The veteran can control the race at his own pace and find extra when challenged, while the crowded field of hold-up horses gets caught in traffic. Forward runners who track the leader avoid the scramble and finish strongest.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If early pace is steady but one of the prominent runners times their challenge perfectly
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses still face traffic issues but one prominent runner gets the ideal trip tracking the leaders before striking at the optimal moment. Late finishers struggle to make up ground against those with positional advantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Navigation
scenarios.trigger: If the large pack of hold-up horses sorts itself out cleanly without major traffic problems
scenarios.body: Superior class tells as the better-rated hold-up horses find racing room and deliver their finishing kicks effectively. The pace-setters begin to tire after controlling the early fractions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses converge simultaneously in the final furlong creating interference
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery as traffic problems and interference affect several fancied runners. An outsider with a clear run or one that benefits from the scrimmaging gets up close home.

watchPoints.text: Hurt You Never must break cleanly and establish early lead as any sluggish start ruins his tactical advantage completely
Traffic problems inevitable in final 2f as eight hold-up horses converge simultaneously from the back of the field
Keldeo and Blue Lakota positioning crucial in first 2f as they need to track leaders without getting caught behind wall of horses
Ground conditions appear consistent but any slight ease in going would disadvantage several runners including Wen Moon and Speeding Bullet
Apprentice Jack Nicholls on Hurt You Never claiming 5lbs but inexperience could cost valuable lengths if pace judgment wrong

races.paceDynamic: Call Me Betty, Magic Boy, and Iris Dancer will ensure a strong gallop from the off in this 6f handicap. With three confirmed front runners and several prominent racers like Counting Cards and Lightning Galaxy positioned just behind, the early pace will be genuinely testing. The strong tempo will stretch the field and expose any lack of stamina, with the leaders likely to come under pressure approaching the final furlong. This aggressive pace scenario strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish fast off the genuine gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If all three leaders go too fast and tie up
scenarios.body: The relentless early gallop will drain the front runners as Surprised, Raft Up, and Mount Ruapehu sweep through with their finishing kicks. Hold-up horses benefit most from the strong pace setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Magic Boy or Call Me Betty can dictate terms
scenarios.body: One of the pace-setters manages the fractions better than the others and holds on grimly from the strong early position. Magic Boy's form at the trip gives him the best chance of the three leaders.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Counting Cards or Mr Dreamseller get perfect positioning
scenarios.body: The prominent racers avoid the early speed battle but stay close enough to pounce when the leaders weaken. Their tactical advantage of being handy but not involved in the pace battle pays dividends.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Moderate Enough
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders settle into a more sustainable rhythm
scenarios.body: The early pace is brisk but not suicidal, allowing the speed horses to maintain their advantage to the line. This requires the jockeys to show restraint despite having three keen front runners.

watchPoints.text: Magic Boy, Call Me Betty, and Iris Dancer must all be monitored for how aggressively they engage early
Surprised and Raft Up need to be positioned within striking distance despite their hold-up styles
Counting Cards dropping back to 6f after 7f failures could unlock improvement
Ran Amok returning from long absence but has winning course form to draw upon
Mount Ruapehu's hold-up style perfectly suits this race shape if positioned correctly

races.paceDynamic: Lord stands alone as the confirmed front-runner with Paul Mulrennan aboard, likely to dictate terms unchallenged in the early stages over this extended distance. Haarar may press from a prominent position, but the majority including As Fast As Wind, Billy No Mates, Ashdown Forest, Swinging London, Cascade Hall and Charlie Darling are hold-up performers who will need the pace to develop. With minimal early pressure on Lord and a large contingent of closers, this sets up as a steady-to-strong gallop that builds gradually, creating a tactical race where horses need to be produced with perfectly-timed runs. This pace dynamic strongly favours hold-up horses and prominent racers with finishing kicks over pure front-runners.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Lord sets an even gallop without serious pressure and the field remains compact turning for home
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up horses get ideal conditions to unleash late runs, with the sustained pace playing to their stamina strengths over this trip. As Fast As Wind and Billy No Mates can capitalise with their proven closing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Tactical Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Haarar or another decides to pressure Lord early, creating a faster tempo through the middle sections
scenarios.body: The stronger gallop stretches the field and benefits horses with tactical speed who can position closer to the pace. Swinging London and Cascade Hall can take advantage of their versatility to secure better racing room.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Lord Dominates Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes pedestrian with no serious challenges to Lord's lead until too late
scenarios.body: The front-runner maintains enough energy to repel late challengers, exploiting the lack of early pressure. Lord's recent third at Redcar suggests he retains sufficient ability when getting soft leads.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Loki Returns With Purpose
scenarios.trigger: If the lightly-raced Loki shows significant improvement from his 199-day absence and overcomes his finishing concerns
scenarios.body: McDonald's booking suggests confidence in the four-year-old's wellbeing, and his class could shine through if the lengthy break has refreshed him. His previous form figures show consistent placing ability.

watchPoints.text: Loki's finishing stamina over this extended trip remains unproven despite his class advantage and could fade in the final furlong
Lord's ability to sustain his early advantage depends entirely on the tempo - any serious pressure could expose his limitations
Haarar's 559-day absence creates massive uncertainty about his current wellbeing and fitness levels
As Fast As Wind's recent return to form suggests he could be peaking at the right time for this suitable pace setup
The large contingent of hold-up horses may create traffic problems in the straight, favouring those who secure clear runs

races.paceDynamic: Lunar Melody is the sole confirmed pace-setter and will break cleanly to establish an uncontested lead, with Dark Sovereign and Wezzeer likely to track in prominent positions but neither aggressive enough to pressure the leader. The middle stages will see a comfortable gallop as the hold-up horses Golden Harvest, Freddie Steady Go, Tzarmaggedon and Great Profit remain patiently positioned at the rear. With just one front runner in an 11-horse field, Lunar Melody can dictate fractions and save energy for the final furlong kick. This race shape strongly favours the front runner and prominent racers who can avoid traffic problems, while the large field of hold-up horses will face a difficult task from the back.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Lunar Melody breaks cleanly and faces no early pressure from the prominent racers.
scenarios.body: The pace-setter can control the tempo completely and kick clear when the field begins their challenge, while the mass of hold-up horses struggle to make up ground from deep positions. Lunar Melody's class advantage and tactical position prove decisive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Dark Sovereign or Wezzeer can stay close enough to Lunar Melody without expending too much energy.
scenarios.body: The prominent racers get a perfect tow into the straight then out-finish the front runner who may have gone too hard to maintain the lead against pressure. Their positioning avoids the traffic that hampers the back markers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Powers Through
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely strong with Lunar Melody going faster than ideal to maintain her advantage.
scenarios.body: The front runners tie up in the final furlong allowing a strong closer like Golden Harvest or Freddie Steady Go to sweep past with a powerful late run. The hold-up horses benefit from the strong gallop.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes messy with multiple horses vying for position and the favorites getting caught up in traffic.
scenarios.body: Chaos in running allows a lightly-raced improver like Albemagic or Bee Farmer to find a clear passage and capitalize on their unexposed potential. The betting favorites all encounter problems.

watchPoints.text: Lunar Melody's early position is crucial - if she misses the break or faces unexpected pressure, the entire pace dynamic collapses.
Golden Harvest and Freddie Steady Go need significant luck in running to get clear passages from their hold-up positions in this field size.
Dark Sovereign's 262-day absence could see him struggling for fitness despite his prominent running style suiting the race shape.
The two completely unexposed runners Albemagic and Bee Farmer could provide surprises if they show more ability than their limited form suggests.
Wezzeer's 7lb penalty for his recent win will test whether his forward-running style can overcome the extra weight burden.

races.paceDynamic: Dandy Orton is the sole confirmed front runner in this field and will dictate a sustainable pace without pressure from the break. With nine hold-up horses behind him, this sets up a classic scenario where the pace-setter can control fractions through the early stages. The lack of early pace pressure means Dandy Orton can settle into comfortable sectionals before the field closes in the final two furlongs. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can track the leader and hold-up horses with a strong finishing kick, as they'll have every chance to make their move in what should develop into a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Favours Finishers
scenarios.trigger: If Dandy Orton establishes an uncontested lead and sets moderate fractions through the first half-mile.
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get the perfect setup with slow early splits, allowing them to close strongly in the final two furlongs when Dandy Orton comes back to them. Thankfully Simmy and Mereside Princess are best positioned to exploit this tactical scenario with their proven finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Dandy Orton gets soft fractions and the field fails to organize a strong pursuit until too late.
scenarios.body: The pace-setter builds an unassailable lead through comfortable splits, with the hold-up brigade leaving their runs too late on this sharp track. Dandy Orton holds on despite his modest rating because he gets first run on rivals who need time to wind up.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Injection Changes Dynamic
scenarios.trigger: If one of the hold-up horses moves earlier than usual to apply pressure to Dandy Orton from the three-furlong pole.
scenarios.body: This creates a more honest pace that stretches the field, suiting horses with tactical speed who can position closer and still have something left. The early injection burns off some finishers while setting up those with natural pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Start Disrupts Shape
scenarios.trigger: If poor breaks or traffic issues leave several runners further back than intended, creating an uneven early distribution.
scenarios.body: The disrupted positioning forces some hold-up horses into worse spots while potentially allowing a mid-division runner to get closer to the pace. This chaos factor can produce a surprise result from an unexpectedly well-positioned runner.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Dandy Orton gets away with soft early fractions - he could steal this race if the field switches off behind him.
Monitor how quickly the hold-up horses begin their moves in the straight, as any delay will play into Dandy Orton's hands on this sharp track.
Keep an eye on Thankfully Simmy and Mereside Princess positioning turning in, as they appear best suited to the likely tactical scenario.
Watch for traffic issues in the straight with nine hold-up horses all needing room to make their runs simultaneously.
Observe how Cobalt Comet handles the switch to good going after his recent runs have all been on slower surfaces.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Dominate

scenarios.body: The prominent group of This Farh, Native Instinct, Vince Le Prince and Bay Breeze will be ideally positioned when the race develops in the final 2f. Hold-up horses will struggle to make up significant ground on the leaders who haven't been softened up by excessive early pace.

scenarios.label: B
